entities.name: Alan Turing
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mathematician and logician who developed the theoretical foundations of computer science with the Turing machine concept (1936). His work at Bletchley Park cracking the Enigma code was critical to Allied victory in WWII, and his ideas on machine intelligence prefigured AI.
